title: AI-Powered website to generate game assets
author: Popular_Welder_8335
selftext:
Hello, I’ve just launched [https://spritefactory.dev/](https://spritefactory.dev/) an AI powered website to generate assets. Would love to get some feedback !

Thank you for reading this and hopefully trying it !

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: What model are you running on the backend?

replies.author: Popular_Welder_8335
replies.body:
For the creation, I'm using gpt-image-2 for the generation and a process of my own to polish it.  
For the animation, I'm using [https://pixelengine.ai/](https://pixelengine.ai/) It's a model trained for animation

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: Interesting. I just generated an image, it said it would cost 1 credit but after confirming I wanted to use my original prompt and starting generation it brought me back to the dialog about prompt enhancement again. I didn't click generate again but it looks like I've spent 2 credits?

replies.author: Popular_Welder_8335
replies.body: Weird, you spent 2 credits and only got 1 gen ? I'll refund you and take a look at it, thanks for the report

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: I appreciate that but no need. I think that because the button in the prompt enhancement modal lined up with the generate button and it triggered the button when the model closed. I tried again and it seemed ok.
